description: Clicks and QR scans across every link in the user's Snip.link account: totals, by day, the busiest links, and the top countries, referring sites and devices. Needs the user signed in to Snip.link. Use this for questions like "how are my links doing" or "which link got the most scans this week".

days.description: How many days back, up to the plan's limit (30 on Free, a year on Pro). Default 30.

links.description: How many of the busiest links to list. Default 10.

name: get_account_stats
title: Get account stats
